name: Stinkface Surprise

source.title: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun

stealth.details: (expert; DC 31 Perception check to detect the hidden bypass button)

disable: DC 26 Thievery check (expert) to unhook the launch spring

items.name: Stinkface Surprise
items.text:
Trigger A creature opens the trunk or breaks open the trunk; Bypass Hidden button

---
Effect The trap deals 4d10+22 poison damage to the triggering creature (DC 26 basic Fortitude save save). On a failure, the target is additionally Blinded and Sickened 4. A creature can spend one Interact action to scrub the filth from their eyes, removing the blinded condition. A creature can't reduce the value of their sickened condition below 1 until they fully wash the filth off, a process which requires 5 minutes and suitable supplies.

text: A pile of excrement and rotten food is launched at whoever opens the trunk without first depressing a hidden button on the side of the trunk.
